title: Build docs/spec.toml from Olympus sections 1-6 with a checking test
summary: Retry of job 20261018-133651-1ncn with the accepted halved scope: docs/spec.toml covers only BRIEF.md "Project Olympus" sections 1 to 6 (vision, pantheon, feedback, example, two loops, R1 to R8), each requirement citing verbatim quotes and headings, checked by an xtask test. Audience is the agents that read the spec and Sri, who approves it. The verifier-timeout mechanism change is a separate job, so the spec is kept compact to be cheap to verify.

defaults_applied.how: Checker and tests are Rust in xtask.
Use the toml and serde crates for parsing; record the TOML choice in docs/decisions.md.
cargo test, clippy -D warnings and fmt --check must pass.
Every requirement cites verbatim quotes from BRIEF.md with headings.
Only sections 1 to 6; no role or prompt changes.
Criteria run the test and negative cases rather than checking that files exist.
Spec and decision text are written for an outside reader.
Behavior criteria name cargo commands the verifier can run.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The new request, as typed, is to retry the spec job; the verifier-timeout redesign suggested by the introspection is not part of it.
Scope stays halved as the user directed: Olympus sections 1 to 6 only; sections 7 to 10, governing philosophy and 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job.
To keep verification inside the deadline, the spec is concise: one requirement per distinct idea, short quotes, merged duplicates, and no padding.
The test lives in xtask/tests/spec.rs and uses the toml crate (bought, not built) added to xtask/Cargo.toml.
Statements about who runs Athena or where are omitted, since xtask/tests/policy.rs forbids Athena files naming them.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test parses docs/spec.toml and passes, meaning every source quote is a verbatim substring of BRIEF.md after collapsing whitespace, ids are unique, supersedes targets exist, and every requirement has at least one source.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: in-memory negative cases each make the checker fail for (a) a quote not in BRIEF.md, (b) a duplicate id, (c) a supersedes target that does not exist, (d) a requirement with no source.

Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a test counts requirements by their sources' headings and finds at least one each for R1 to R8 and for Olympus sections 1 to 5 (Vision, Pantheon, Feedback, Example, lifecycle with the two loops).

Each requirement in docs/spec.toml has an id, a plain cohesive statement, a kind (goal, requirement, constraint, acceptance), a status (active or superseded), and one or more sources (verbatim quote plus heading); duplicates are merged into one requirement with several sources.

docs/spec.toml records at least one open question with both verbatim quotes where Sri's words conflict or leave a choice open, unresolved; if sections 1 to 6 contain none, the spec says so and the format and test still support the field.
docs/spec.toml has no statement about who runs Athena or where; xtask/tests/policy.rs still passes.
Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo test`: all clean and passing.

CHANGELOG.md has an entry for the spec; docs/decisions.md records the spec format and the choice of TOML with alternatives (Markdown with ids, JSON, YAML), and notes that sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job.

out_of_scope: Olympus sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda (second job)
Changing any reader or prompt to use the spec
Changing the verifier's timeout or outcome mechanism
departures: Verification pass is lowered from the reference because the previous attempt of this same job hit the verifier's 1200s deadline and the timeout mechanism is unchanged; wall time is raised for the same reason.
